# PR #2838: Patch: cargo jackioh fx census: what each card's plays and hooks do on the board, from recorded games

Closes #2788

## What changed

New `cargo jackioh fx census [--seeds N] [--format md|json] [--out <path>]` command for the #2782 set passes, in four files:

- [fx_census.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2788/crates/tools/src/fx_census.rs) (new, 1504 lines): plays `--seeds` random-policy base games over every shipped set, then forced games carrying each rarely-seen card, so every deckable non-token card reaches `FX_CENSUS_MIN_SEEN` plays or is listed unseen with a reason. Per card and hook it reports event counts, target counts, sides, lanes, random splits, graveyard returns, own-unit costs, `via` keywords, and a motif suggested through one cited mapping section (`FAMILY_EVENTS`, `FAMILY_MOTIFS`, `damage_motif`) off the motif table's "Reads" column. Play windows run `cardPlayed`→`cardResolved`/`countered`; hook windows run marker→marker, with a synthetic `fire` window for Traps; prompts keep windows open. Output is a set-grouped Markdown table or JSON, to stdout or `--out`; failed games are reported, never fatal. Pure crates untouched.
- [main.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2788/crates/tools/src/main.rs): `Command::Fx` plus its match arm.
- [README.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2788/crates/tools/README.md): the command-table row.
- [9-card-animations.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2788/docs/polish/9-card-animations.md): one bullet under `## Open` recording the `rise`/`offering` names.

## How tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools fx_census`: 20/20 pass (one fixture test per motif family, split, one-lane, graveyard return, own-unit cost, vanilla, no-motif, window rules, `via`, unseen reasons, md/json shape, forced-games integration, 1-vs-4-thread determinism).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools`: full crate green (480+27+1+3+3+4, 0 failed), including `readme_the_command_table_is_the_clis`.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check` (1625 rulings ok), `classify --base origin/main --claims` → Internal.
- Live release runs: `--seeds 20` md and json both report 753 cards (634 non-token + 119 tokens seen), 1151 forced games, 0 failed; Lunar Eclipse reads `bolt`. Full default (`--seeds 200`) was not run here; CI covers the gate.

## Decisions the issue left open

- `fire` window for Traps (no marker exists; otherwise every Trap reads vanilla) over attributing counters to the victim's play.
- Random split as a heuristic (one source hitting one target twice outside combat) over a new stream marker.
- Cost from the action's `tributes` (tribute deaths precede `cardPlayed`) over reading `destroyed` events.
- `none`/`spread` lane values added; `chain`/`scorch` never suggested (events can't distinguish them); failures reported, exit stays 0.

Reviewer, look twice at: `Tracker::observe`'s hook-vs-play attribution (another card's trigger stays out of a play only when a marker names it), and `damage_motif` rule order (split → one-lane → no-damage → both-sides → multi-target → single).

Approved on round 1 of 3.

- `crates/tools/src/fx_census.rs:552`: The banish family always suggests vanish though the doc reads exiled for lance and wipe too, and chain/scorch are unreachable by construction.
- `crates/tools/src/fx_census.rs:139`: Same-step destroy-and-resummon never reads as a graveyard return, and a countered event with no open hook folds nowhere.
